newsitem.title: USA: CNA Financial, Capsure form largest surety company.
newsitem.headline: CNA Financial, Capsure form largest surety company.

text.p: CNA Financial Corp. and Capsure Holdings Corp. said Thursday they would form a new stock company, CNA Surety Corp., which will be the largest surety bond company in the United States.

On a pro forma basis, CNA Surety's net written premiums for the 12 months ended Sept. 30 would total $232.8 million of a total surety market of $2.7 billion, making it 30 percent larger than the next largest U.S. surety operation.

Under the deal, CNA Financial, through its subsidiaries, will receive 61.75 percent of the common stock of CNA Surety. The remaining 38.25 percent will be split between current Capsure shareholders and option holders, with current Capsure option holders receiving equivalent options on CNA Surety stock, the companies said.
CNA Financial and Capsure said the combined surety operations of Capsure and CNA will operate through Capsure's two operating subsidiaries, Western Surety Co and Universal Surety of America.
The companies said the merger presents what were described as "significant opportunities for expense savings" over the next two or three years.
The merger should benefit both companies, an analyst said.

"A large, well-funded company like CNA can take Capsure's expertise in the surety business and really expand it throughout the country," said Gary Prestopino, an analyst at Mesirow Financial. "(Buying Capsure) is a really low risk compared to other players in the insurance industry."
A CNA spokesman said there were no personnel eliminations anticipated at this time.
The transaction is subject to approval of the shareholders of Capsure and insurance regulators in the South Dakota and Texas, where Western and Universal are respectively based.
CNA Financial is the parent company of the CNA insurance companies, is one of the 10 largest U.S. insurance organisations. Capsure Holdings Corp provides surety and fidelity bonds in 50 states.
